Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
This is ripped from the Path of Blood spoiler, so it's not guaranteed
to be 100% accurate in it's wording.

But the following card caught my eye.

-----
Hall of Hades Court R
Act Mod/React
1 Blood
Only usable during a referendum
[dom] [act mod] Requires a vampire with a capacity above 4. This
vampire gains 2 votes.
[tem] [act mod][react] Cancel a reaction card as it is played by a
younger vampire who does not have temporis (no costs are paid)
[TEM] [act mod][react] Multiplier. Only usable by a ready untapped
vampire other than the acting vampire. The acting Vampire's votes are
doubled when votes are tallied. Only one multiplier can be played on a
vampire each action.
-----

Namely the TEM ability. Does the "acting Vampire's votes" apply to
those listed for titles, or does it apply to all votes gained from any
source (Bewitching Oration/Iron Glare)? I'd assume the latter, but
there are numerous times I've assumed something and had it be
incorrect.

Morgan Vening
